notes: The whole mole attack on the ground under the target: cracks spread across a 3:2 ellipse, the ground darkens, light leaks through the cracks, pebbles hop, dust trickles up around the edge. Indexed by wind-up progress (frame = progress * 19), not played, so it fits any wind-up length; the cracks reach the edge on the last frame = the hit, then the game fades that frame out. Ground ellipse is 64x43 px (visible_w 64), shown at 2x. Anchor = strike centre. Apollo.
